Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material.why: Makes single-lane 224G high-speed copper communication cable, in scaled delivery as the main product of its high-speed cable business, and pushes it into AI computing and data centers (448G in customer validation); high-speed cable revenue rose 237.99% in 2025, so AI data-center copper interconnect build-out directly drives its communication cable segment.
Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material.evidence: Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026): single-lane 224G high-speed communication cable keeps adding variants and remains in scaled delivery as the main product of the high-speed cable business; H1 2026 high-speed communication cable revenue RMB 6.31 hundred million, up 35.44%; the company is promoting high-speed cable applications in AI computing and data centers.

players.product: Single-lane 224G high-speed copper communication cable (twinax wire for DAC / server cable assemblies); single-lane 448G cable in customer validation and PCIe 7.0 high-speed cable in small-batch trial production
